chapter: Race, rock and the craft of vocalese
title: Zoot Sims's compliment
summary: Zoot Sims told him he outblew him despite practicing five hours a day.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Yeah. What is it? One of the quotations that said that not only do you sing the solos, but sometimes you outdo the originals. I think that’s fantastic.

I was paid a very high compliment by Zoot Sims one time. I came into this bar. I says, “Hey, Zoot.” He says, “Hey, Jon. How you doin’?” I said, “I’m okay.” He said, “I got to tell you.” He says, “You make me mad.” I says, “What’d I do?” He said, “I practice my horn five hours a day.” He said, “Then you come up there, and you don’t even know nothin’, and you outblow me.” I said, “Oh, thank you, Zoot.” He says, “Thanks, nothin’. I ain’t kiddin’.” I was giving him a hug. But he was serious. But I took that as a very high compliment. And I think it was. I think that’s a high compliment.
